study_design: Nested case-control study within the prospective CLUE II cohort
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Included in the analysis were 115 prostate cancer cases and 227 age-matched controls nested in the prospective CLUE II study located in Washington County, MD.
reason: The abstract evaluates subsequent overall prostate cancer risk using prediagnostic toenail biomarkers but does not analyze an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: We evaluated the association between prediagnostic toenail cadmium and zinc concentrations and risk of prostate cancer in a cohort in which the primary route of exposure to cadmium and zinc is the diet.
estimate_classifications.reason: The row concerns zinc and overall prostate cancer risk; no aggressive subtype is specified.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Prostate cancer risk did not increase with increasing concentrations of cadmium (P trend = 0.9) and did not decrease with increasing concentrations of zinc (P trend = 0.2).
estimate_classifications.reason: This is an overall prostate cancer association for toenail zinc, not an aggressive incidence estimate.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
